_meta.description: Partial-depth column normalization on a nested column axis. With normalize_level=0 the top-level region grouper constitutes the 100% denominator: every cell under a shared region (across both segment leaves) sums to 1. Long shape with margins.columns: true emits both the leaf _margin=column rows and the partial _margin=column_at_0 rows.
_meta.name: crosstab_partial_column_normalize_level
